subject.title: Feature: Granular Discord action gates (split actions.messages into read/edit/delete)

question: What permanent Discord message-permission schema and upgrade behavior should OpenClaw support for independently controlling send, read, edit, and delete?
rationale: This changes a shipped configuration and security boundary; source inspection can establish the missing capability but cannot choose precedence, defaults, migration behavior, or whether compatibility outweighs a cleaner canonical shape.

options.title: Canonical granular map
options.body: Replace the boolean with a canonical per-action object and provide a tested `openclaw doctor --fix` migration from existing true/false values.

options.title: Additive override gates
options.body: Keep `actions.messages` as the parent boolean and add optional per-action overrides with explicitly documented precedence and defaults.

options.title: Keep the coarse gate
options.body: Decline new configuration surface and document that deployments must rely on Discord-side permissions and operational policy for destructive actions.

recommendation.title: Canonical granular map
recommendation.body: Replace the boolean with a canonical per-action object and provide a tested `openclaw doctor --fix` migration from existing true/false values.
